text:
Type: green linen-look cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: woven linen-look fabric with a fine slub texture, plain sewn edge
Colors: medium leaf green, slightly warm
Shape: square plump cushion with a solid colored surface, softly rounded corners, simple flat seam, medium size
Feel: fresh, natural, relaxed
Goes with: natural wood, rattan, cream or grey sofas, green plants; Scandinavian or bohemian living rooms

product.name: VIGDIS
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
